title: SessionAutoWakeOutlook.v2
description: Advisory broker snapshot of the recipient's idle wake (doorbell) path at checkedAt. A wake only asks the recipient to look at its inbox; delivery is the claim/ACK path. It is not delivery, processing, completion, approval or permission evidence, and it never removes or re-sends a queued message.

state.description: available: a live relay can ring, or a rung wake is waiting for its resend time. degraded: this birth's wake keeps failing or lacks a prerequisite; queued messages are taken only at the recipient's own next claim boundary (turn end, tool boundary or prompt). unsupported: the recipient's declared capabilities have no idle wake. no-live-relay: no online presence or relay lease can ring.

reason.description: relay-live: a wake can be rung. wake-in-flight: handed to the host inside the 60-second observation window. wake-unanswered: the window passed with no answer; the host may hold or have dropped it, and the slot frees at the resend time. recipient-active: the recipient recently passed a claim boundary. retry-backoff: waiting after a transient failure. wake-failing: consecutive transient failures reached the limit. wake-prerequisite-missing: this birth lacks a wake prerequisite. no-idle-wake: declared without idle wake. presence-unknown, presence-not-online, relay-lease-missing: why no relay can ring.

basisAt.description: Time of the stored fact behind reason: relay lease renewal, hand-off time, resend time, last claim boundary, retry deadline, last failure, decision time, birth, presence lease end, or presence heartbeat when a relay lease is missing. Null when no presence was ever recorded.
